Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can choose to not digivolve. In such cases, you return all of the revealed cards to the bottom of your deck in any order.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to reveal cards from my deck, but then choose to not digivolve?

Card Q&A.a: You perform the digivolution bonus draw when this card is placed on top of that Digimon for the digivolution, and you draw from the unrevealed cards in your deck. A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules. After the card to digivolve is stacked and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you process the remaining effects.
Card Q&A.q: When a digivolution would occur by this card's [When Attacking] effect, when exactly is the timing for the digivolution bonus draw, and where do I draw from?
If I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to digivolve, can I activate the digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect before returning the remaining cards to the bottom of the deck?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. In such cases, you reveal as many cards from your deck as possible.
Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's [When Attacking] effect when I have 2 or fewer cards in my deck?

Effect: [When Attacking] Reveal 3 cards from the top of your deck. You can digivolve this card into 1 level 6 green Digimon card among them without paying its memory cost. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
